summary.text: Josh Heintzeman is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 6B who is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He first won a House seat in 2014, representing District 10A from 2015 to 2023, and faces Democrat Nicky Hardy in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Josh Heintzeman defeated incumbent Democrat John Ward in the 2014 general election for District 10A and held that seat from 2015 to 2023.
He won re-election in 2016, 2018 and 2020, then ran in District 6B in 2022, defeating Sally Boos in the general election.
He won the 2024 general election over Emily LeClaire and Troy Scheffler and the August 2026 Republican primary.
Heintzeman's 2025-2026 committee assignments are Commerce Finance and Policy, Environment and Natural Resources Finance and Policy (Co-Chair), Legacy Finance, and Ways and Means.
